verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
verses.sm: An lo latou Atua, na auina mai ai o ia e le ALII lo latou Atua ia te i latou, o ia upu uma lava, ona fai mai ai lea o Asaraia le atalii o Hosaia, ma Ioanana le atalii o Karea,

verses.en: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
verses.sm: ma tagata faamaualuluga uma, oa faapea mai ia Ieremia, O le pepelo ua e fai mai ai; e lei auina mai oe e le ALII lo tatou Atua, ia faapea mai, Aua tou te o atu i Aikupito e āumau ai;

verses.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
verses.sm: a o Paruka le atalii o Neria, ua ia faaosoina oe ia te i matou, ina ia tuuina atu i matou i lima o Kaletaia, e fasioti i matou, ma tafea i matou i Papelonia.

verses.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua le faalogo Ioanana le atalii o Karea, ma alii uma na ave ‘au, ma le nuu uma, i le siufofoga o le ALII, ia latou nonofo i le nuu o Iuta;

verses.en: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;
verses.sm: a o Ioanana le atalii o Karea, ma alii uma na ave ‘au, ua latou ave i e na totoe uma o luta, o e na foi mai ai nuu uma na tulia ai i latou, e nonofo i le nuu o Iuta;

verses.en: Even men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
verses.sm: o tane, ma fafine, ma tama iti, ma afafine o le tupu, ma tagata uma na tuua e Nepusatana le pule i le ‘au e faafeao ia Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo, le atalii o Safana, atoa ma Ieremia le perofeta, ma Paruka le atalii o Neria.

verses.en: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
verses.sm: Ona latou o atu ai lea i le nuu o Aikupito; aua na latou le faalogo i le siufofoga o le ALII; ua 00 atu lava i latou i Tapenesa.

verses.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le afioga a le ALn ia Ieremia i Tapenesa, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;
verses.sm: Ina ave ia i ou lima ni maa tetele, ma tanu ai i le paluga panisina i le mea e tunu ai maaomea, O loo i ai i le mea e ui ai ile fale o Farao i Tapenesa, i luma o tagata o Iuta;

verses.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
verses.sm: ia e fai atu foi ia te i latou, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Faauta, ou te auina atu e aami laʻu auauna o Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, ma ou tuuina lona nofoālii i luga o ia maa ua ou tanua; na te fofola foi lona ie matagofie i o latou luga.

verses.en: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
verses.sm: E sau foi o ia, na te fasia le nuu o Aikupito; na te tuuina atu foi o e ua tofia ia oti, i le oti, ma e ua tofia i le tafeaga, ia tāfea, ma e ua tofia i le pelu, ia oti i le pelu.

verses.en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
verses.sm: Ou te tutu foi le afi i fale o atua o Aikupito; na te susunuina foi i latou, ma avea i latou o tagata O taua; na te taaia foi le nuu o Aikupito, e pei ona taaia e le leoleo mamoe lona ofu; e alu ese foi o ia i lea mea ma le filemu.

verses.en: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
verses.sm: Na te tuʻininiia foi tupua o le fale o le Ia, o loo i ai i le nuu o Aikupito; o fale foi o atua o Aikupito, na te susunuina i le afi. O le malaia o
